title_en: Here's When You Can Play and Preload All the Different Parts of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Where You Live
summary_en: Activision has confirmed the global release times and preload details for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, which launches in various parts over the coming weeks.
body_en:
Activision has confirmed the global release times and preload details for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , which launches in various parts over the coming weeks.
Modern Warfare 4 (full game including Multiplayer) officially launches on October 23 across all platforms, but you’ll be able to play the campaign a week before that with Early Access, which kicks off on October 16. DMZ, Modern Warfare 4's extraction mode, is available from October 20.
Whether you’re playing Modern Warfare 4 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series consoles, or Nintendo Switch 2, this post will cover everything you need to know about getting those boots on the ground: release times, preload details, Early Access launch, and more.
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 global release times:
As I said above, Modern Warfare 4 officially comes out on October 23, but what time you’ll get access depends on whether you have Early Access and what platform you plan to play on.
Modern Warfare 4 players on PC will be able to jump on at midnight local time on the morning of October 23. Wherever you’re based, the game will unlock at midnight. If it doesn’t trigger straight away, fully close and exit Steam — a relaunch should trigger it.
Campaign Early Access for Modern Warfare 4 begins on October 16, 2026, for players who digitally preorder the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game. For people who bought physical, there’s no Early Access for preorders of the Standard Edition.
Additionally, players who preordered will get Early Access to DMZ mode, which kicks off on October 20.
Here’s a look at the Modern Warfare 4 editions:
Preload for Modern Warfare 4 will begin rolling out on October 14 at 9pm PT. Here’s how that looks for other regions:
During setup, you can choose which content to download, including whether to install Warzone alongside Modern Warfare 4. The new version of Warzone will not be available until the launch of Season 1.
Xbox players should be able to circumvent regional restrictions with the New Zealand trick , where they change their in-game timezone to New Zealand in the settings, tricking their console into letting them pre-install and play early.
According to the official Modern Warfare 4 system requirements, the game will need 115GB of available SSD space on PC. Console versions may vary — and it’ll depend what content you decide to download — but they’ll likely be somewhat similar.
